question: Does the access layer leave an observable signature before OT-facing collection begins?
hypothesis: If SYLVANITE handed access to VOLTZITE, then edge-appliance audit logs will show a newly created local administrator account followed within 14 days by domain-account logons and credential dumping on the same estate
closure: Confirmed if at least two incidents show the three stages in order within 14 days. Refuted if, across three public incident reports or 90 days of telemetry, broker-stage artefacts are absent in the majority, or the OT-facing stage systematically precedes them. A negative result closes the hunt for that window; it does not establish that the actor is absent.
